content.text: {"core": "Recognition looks back at what has already happened and names it — this counted, that did not. Seated in its own position, what gets weighed is the weighing itself: how things come to be called finished or worthy. Kept quiet, the verdict runs without being heard — old rulings stay in force while the sorting that made them never comes up for review.", "sheetLine": "The old verdict keeps ruling; the sorting behind it was never called out loud."}
